# Figure report: FluoForge reference figure

FluoForge {{version}}. 2 pages of 1200 × 800 px at 300 dpi (101.6 × 67.73 mm).

## Methods

Figure panels were assembled in FluoForge {{version}} (4 image panels from 2 source files). Panel 1 shows reference-cells.tif (320 × 240 px, 3 channels, 16-bit, 0.5 µm/px); Ch 1 in grey (display range 0–60000), Ch 2 in red (display range 0–50000) and Ch 3 in green (display range 0–60000). Panel 2 shows reference-raster.png (160 × 120 px, 3 channels, 8-bit); Red in red (display range 0–255), Green in green (display range 0–255) and Blue in blue (display range 0–255). Panel 3 (an inset) shows reference-cells.tif (320 × 240 px, 3 channels, 16-bit, 0.5 µm/px), cropped to 60 × 46.67 px (30 × 23.333 µm); Ch 1 in grey (display range 0–60000), Ch 2 in red (display range 0–50000) and Ch 3 in green (display range 0–60000). Panel 4 shows reference-cells.tif (320 × 240 px, 3 channels, 16-bit, 0.5 µm/px), cropped to 180 × 180 px (90 × 90 µm), masked to an ellipse; Ch 1 in grey (display range 0–60000), Ch 2 in red (display range 0–50000) and Ch 3 in green (display range 0–60000). Display ranges were applied as linear scaling between the minimum and maximum, to the whole image. Panels were exported at 300 dpi from the source pixels, averaged where a panel is printed smaller than its source region and never enlarged.
